title.narrative: Roundtable for Civil Society and Justice
Roundtable for Civil Society and Justice

description.narrative: Insatsen syftar till att tillhandahålla ett tekniskt utrymme för guatemalanska civilsamhällesorganisationer specialiserade på mänskliga rättigheter, säkerhet och rättvisa, för alliansbyggande och opinionsbildningsinsatser fokuserade på främjandet av en demokratisk agenda och insatser för att hindra en ytterligare tillbakagång för mänskliga rättigheter i landet.

The contribution aims to provide a technical space for Guatemalan Civil Society Organizations specialized on human rights, security and justice, for articulation and advocacy efforts focused on the promotion of a democratic agenda and the containment of the regressive trends on the country.

This short term contribution is aimed to provide a technical space for Guatemalan civil society organizations specialized on human rights, security and justice, for articulation and advocacy efforts focused on the promotion of a democratic agenda.

The partner is making important advances on the discussion of sensitive issues on regard of justice and security in Guatemala. The space is proving their importance, as it provides opportunity for the political dialogue of several actors, with different approaches to the justice and security agenda.
